business.summary: Tata Elxsi Limited is a global provider of design-led technology services, embedded systems, and product engineering solutions. The company operates across verticals including Transportation (Mobility), Media & Communications, and Healthcare & Life Sciences, leveraging advanced digital technologies, design thinking, and artificial intelligence.

bull: Transportation business achieved a year-on-year growth of 3.9% with strategic wins in Software Defined Vehicles (SDV) and increasing OEM revenue contribution up to around 75%.
Media & Communications posted a strong sequential growth of 9.5% in the final quarter of FY 2025-26, signaling a return to a growth trajectory.
Strong commitments and progress in sustainability, achieving a 72.7% reduction in GHG emissions intensity per employee and increasing renewable energy use to 66%.
bear: Healthcare & Life Sciences business experienced a year-on-year decline of 10.7% impacted by the end of large regulatory programmes with lead customers.
Overall operating revenues for FY 2025-26 reflected modest growth of only 0.8% to 3,757.40 crore amidst challenging global headwinds.
Media & Communications overall annual revenue saw a degrowth of 1.2% year-on-year due to subdued business environments and clients reducing capex overhangs.
